# ControllerX

ControllerX is an AppDaemon app for Home Assistant that turns button
controllers (IKEA, Philips Hue, Aqara, Tuya, etc.) into fully working
light, media player, switch and cover controllers. Each app is
configured in AppDaemon's `apps.yaml` with `module: controllerx`, a
device-specific `class` (e.g. `E1810Controller`), the `integration`
that receives the button events (z2m, deconz, zha, ...), the
`controller` ID and the entity to control (e.g. `light`). Holding a
button repeats a Home Assistant service call until it is released.
Default button mappings can be replaced with a custom `mapping`.

A machine-readable list of the supported devices, with their
controller classes and default mappings, is available at
https://xaviml.github.io/controllerx/controllers/devices.json

## Getting started

- [ControllerX](<https://xaviml.github.io/controllerx/index.md>): What ControllerX is and a quick example
- [Installation](<https://xaviml.github.io/controllerx/start/installation/index.md>): Install ControllerX in Home Assistant
- [Configuration](<https://xaviml.github.io/controllerx/start/configuration/index.md>): Generic app parameters for apps.yaml
- [Type Configuration](<https://xaviml.github.io/controllerx/start/type-configuration/index.md>): Parameters for light, media player, switch and cover controllers
- [Configuration builder](<https://xaviml.github.io/controllerx/start/config-builder/index.md>): Interactive apps.yaml generator
